source: NASA Artemis III Candidate Landing Regions (NASA Release 22-088, August 2022; Lunar Resources Registry & LPI/USRA cartographic databases)
disclaimer: Observer coordinates represent documented candidate regional center/ridge crest points within the 15x15 km Artemis III exploration boxes. For mission planning and educational exploration; not flight certified.

sites.name: Peak Near Shackleton
sites.description: High-standing ridge crest adjacent to Shackleton Crater featuring near-continuous solar illumination and direct line-of-sight to deep volatile cold traps.

sites.name: Connecting Ridge
sites.description: Prominent high-elevation saddle feature connecting the rims of Shackleton and de Gerlache craters, offering exceptional strategic vantage.

sites.name: Malapert Massif
sites.description: Massive elevated mountain block rising over 5,000 meters above surrounding terrain, providing unparalleled direct-with-Earth communication visibility.

sites.name: Faustini Rim A
sites.description: Elevated rim segment of Faustini Crater flanked by permanently shadowed regions containing potential surface and subsurface water ice.

sites.name: de Gerlache Rim 1
sites.description: Eastern high rim of de Gerlache Crater with sustained solar exposure and moderate terrain slopes.

sites.name: Nobile Rim 1
sites.description: Western elevated rim of Nobile Crater situated along ancient South Pole-Aitken basin highland terrain.
